when s the best time to fly out of okc.question: When's the best time to fly out of OKC?
when s the best time to fly out of okc.sql: SELECT DEP_HOUR, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(DEP_DEL15), 1) AS PCT_DELAYED, COUNT(*) AS FLIGHTS FROM FLIGHTS WHERE ORIGIN = 'OKC' GROUP BY DEP_HOUR HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30 ORDER BY PCT_DELAYED ASC LIMIT 500
when s the best time to fly out of okc.answer: The best time to fly is at 5, as only 6.1% of flights are delayed. Delays increase significantly later in the day, reaching 63.6% by 21.

which airline is most reliable.question: Which airline is most reliable?
which airline is most reliable.sql: SELECT CARRIER_NAME, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(DEP_DEL15), 1) AS PCT_DELAYED, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CANCELLED), 2) AS PCT_CANCELLED, COUNT(*) AS FLIGHTS FROM FLIGHTS GROUP BY CARRIER_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000 ORDER BY PCT_DELAYED ASC LIMIT 500
which airline is most reliable.answer: Envoy Air is the most reliable airline with a 20.4% delay rate. It also has a low cancellation rate of 2.01%.

which day of the week has the worst dela.question: Which day of the week has the worst delays?
which day of the week has the worst dela.sql: SELECT DAY_OF_WEEK, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(DEP_DEL15), 1) AS PCT_DELAYED, ROUND(AVG(DEP_DELAY), 1) AS AVG_DEP_DELAY, COUNT(*) AS FLIGHTS FROM FLIGHTS GROUP BY DAY_OF_WEEK HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30 ORDER BY AVG_DEP_DELAY DESC LIMIT 500
which day of the week has the worst dela.answer: Day 7 has the worst delays with a 31.8% delay rate. The average delay on this day is 22.8.

what are the worst routes for delays.question: What are the worst routes for delays?
what are the worst routes for delays.sql: SELECT ORIGIN || '-' || DEST AS ROUTE, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(DEP_DEL15), 1) AS PCT_DELAYED, COUNT(*) AS FLIGHTS FROM FLIGHTS GROUP BY ORIGIN || '-' || DEST HAVING COUNT(*) >= 200 ORDER BY PCT_DELAYED DESC LIMIT 10
what are the worst routes for delays.answer: The route MRY-SFO has the highest delay rate at 61.5%. The MDW-SEA route follows with a delay rate of 59.1%.

how do cancellations change by month.question: How do cancellations change by month?
how do cancellations change by month.sql: SELECT MONTH, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CANCELLED), 1) AS PCT_CANCELLED, COUNT(*) AS FLIGHTS FROM FLIGHTS GROUP BY MONTH ORDER BY MONTH LIMIT 500
how do cancellations change by month.answer: Cancellations rose from 1.7% in June to 2.6% in July. The rate decreased to 1.9% in August.
